envelope.label: FZP envelope in stories

sources.label: DataSF Zoning Map – Height and Bulk Districts

envelope.method: Stories = min(80, floor(height ft / 10)) (orchestrator rule, tier 3) on the adopted FZP height string of the district with the largest overlap: the Local Program height on Local Program parcels, else the base side. The base height is the current string’s left side, used as the height in force for every roll year (no pre-FZP height map exists, tier 3).

localProgram.label: Local Program eligibility

sources.label: DataSF Zoning Map – Height and Bulk Districts
DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls

localProgram.method: R-4 bulk from h9wh-cg3m; exclusions approximated from wv5m-vpq2; register listings not modelled (assumed eligible, tier 4). Rent control: ≥ 3 non-condo units built before 1979 on the latest roll; hotels: hotel property classes (motels eligible). Lots of 8,000 sf or more get at least 65 ft (§206.10(d)(1)(C)); corner lots are not modelled, so they are understated.

features.label: Redevelopment features (assessor roll)

sources.label: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls

features.method: Per parcel from the 2025 secured roll (lien date 1 January), roll rows mapped to current parcels through acdm-wktn (retired lots by centroid). Imputations are tier 2: missing year built and improvement share take the median of the same land-use class and roll year (a year-wide median, then 0, when the class has none: tier 4); missing stories come from the building height. Sanity rules (tier 4, made up): roll stories above 80 are missing; a bracketed run of implausible units (≥ 100 and over 10× its neighbouring years) takes the previous year’s units (imputed bit 3). Parcels without a latest-year roll row take the "other" class medians. Assessed values reflect the Prop 13 acquisition basis, not market value. Base-zoning density caps from the Planning Code (tier 1, pipeline/lib/density-caps.ts); a split zoning code takes its most permissive component and generic NCD/NCT codes have no cap (both tier 4, made up); districts not verified against the official Code default to no cap (NCD, NCT).

existingUnits.label: Existing homes (assessor)

sources.label: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls

existingUnits.method: Σ number_of_units over the parcel’s roll rows in the latest roll year (2025); no LUDB fallback. A parcel without a latest-year row has 0. An implausible bracketed run (≥ 100 units and over 10× the neighbouring years) takes the previous year’s value (tier 4, imputed bit 3).

yield.label: Units by fill level

sources.label: DataSF Zoning Map – Height and Bulk Districts
DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls

yield.method: Gross units from the project’s typology generator (src/lib/generator, mode max, seed fnv1a32(id)), replacement typologies only, at max(1, round(fill × stories)) for each FILL_LEVELS fill (a tier-4 quantisation grid). FZP yields have no density cap on Local Program parcels and the cap on 2026-10-10 elsewhere; base yields use the base height and the pre-FZP cap (2026-01-11). Base-zoning density caps from the Planning Code (tier 1, pipeline/lib/density-caps.ts); a split zoning code takes its most permissive component and generic NCD/NCT codes have no cap (both tier 4, made up); districts not verified against the official Code default to no cap (NCD, NCT).
